laws.rule: Since 10 August 2026, walking through Hoi An's old town is free; the old VND 120,000 ticket for foreigners has gone. Each heritage building charges VND 20,000 a person (about A$1.10, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), the same for Vietnamese and foreign visitors; under 16s are free.
